hero.title: Dayara Bugyal Meadow Trek
hero.bookingText: Visit peaktrails.in/dayara for full details & booking

overview.text: Dayara Bugyal is one of the largest and most beautiful high-altitude meadows in the Garhwal Himalayas, offering sweeping views of Bandarpoonch and the Gangotri range.

itinerary.title: Drive to Raithal & Trek to Base Camp
itinerary.description: Drive from Uttarkashi to Raithal, then trek through oak and pine forest to reach base camp.

itinerary.title: Dayara Bugyal Meadow & Sunset Point
itinerary.description: Trek to the open meadows of Dayara Bugyal, taking in panoramic Himalayan views before returning to camp.

itinerary.title: Descent to Raithal & Drive Back
itinerary.description: Descend to Raithal village and drive back to Uttarkashi. Trip concludes.

inclusions.title: Camping
inclusions.description: Tented accommodation on a triple/quad sharing basis.

inclusions.title: Meals
inclusions.description: All vegetarian meals from Day 1 lunch to Day 3 breakfast.

inclusions.title: Trek Support
inclusions.description: Certified trek leader and support staff.

inclusions.title: First Aid
inclusions.description: Oximeter, first-aid kit and emergency evacuation support.

faqs.question: Is this trek beginner-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, Dayara Bugyal is ideal for first-time trekkers with a basic fitness level.

faqs.question: What is the best season?
faqs.answer: March to June and September to December offer the best conditions.
